messages:
Maya: heads-up — running into an edge case with the canary gatekeeper and header exceptions. some enterprise customers include a `x-tenant-routing` header that bypasses our usual splitter, which is breaking canary sampling.
Jordan: ah, are they explicitly setting a priority header that our matcher treats as authoritative?
Maya: yes. the matcher docs say header-first, but we already have tenants who rely on a tenant header for sticky routing. when canary is enabled we want to divert X% of traffic but not override tenant-level isolation.
Samir: can you paste the policy snippet? might be a small rule-order change.
Maya: copied — this is what the console generates for the canary route currently:
```
{
  "match": [{ "header": "x-tenant-routing", "exists": true }],
  "action": { "type": "forward", "target": "customer-pool" }
}
{
  "match": [{ "fraction": 0.05 }],
  "action": { "type": "forward", "target": "canary-v2" }
}
```
Lee: yep — header rule is earlier so it short-circuits the fraction sampling. two options: 1) make header rules explicit exceptions (i.e., if header present, allow sampling only if tenant opt-in), or 2) change evaluation to run fraction checks before tenant-match but add tenant-isolation clause.
Ana: UX question — if we add an "exceptions" checkbox in the canary wizard to opt-out tenants with `x-tenant-routing`, will that be discoverable? ops teams might miss it.
Jordan: prefer making the platform safer by default. automatic exception list: any route that has `persistent=true` or `isolated=true` metadata gets a priority flag that prevents weight-split. then add an override with a forced-ack in Console (two-step).
Samir: from telemetry perspective we need to tag samples that were forced by override so we can filter regressions. add a `routing:forced_canary=true` span tag.
Maya: agree. also current quota accounting gets weird when a tenant is partially diverted — billing shows two routes but quota bucket remains single. need to decide whether to split quota usage or attribute to primary tenant.
Lee: split quotas by route when traffic fraction > 0.1% to avoid rounding noise. smaller than that treat as telemetry-only and bill to primary.
Ana: for Console UX: show a badge on tenants that are "canary-eligible" vs "canary-exempt", with hover tooltip that lists the reason (header override, reserved-customer flag, manual-exempt).
Jordan: implementation plan: (a) add tenant metadata flags and default rule to block weight-splits for isolated tenants, (b) add two-step override in Console with audit log + `routing:forced_canary` tag when used, (c) change quota accounting rule to split when fraction >= 0.001, (d) emit telemetry for every decision with reason code.
Maya: ok can we PR a small RFC? I'll sketch the policy ordering change and the rejection codes. will ping infra for quota schema change.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: policy-service v1.42 -> canary on infra-staging in 3m :rocket:
Samir: thanks — adding a quick eval checklist: 1) stateless sampling preserved, 2) tenant isolation tests, 3) billing attribution smoke, 4) telemetry tags present.
Maya: perfect. I'll open RFC and link the checklist. tagging @Lee for quota follow-up. :thumbsup:
